note: A variable's coverage: Avbrott is delivered 2010..2012 and again from 2016 with no end. The open-ended state counts only its opening year (as `get availability` did), so the years stop at 2016 and 2013..2015 are gaps; each year lists the column delivered in it. Fails if the open end is enumerated to its 9999 sentinel or dropped, a gap is missed, or the column per year is lost.
